Game Overview

Doctor Acorn 2 is a clicker title where embark on an acorn-filled journey as you guide Doctor Acorn through intricate mazes. Toggle fans to navigate his path, collect stars, and conquer bird foes across ten thrilling levels. Experience whimsical fun and clever puzzle-solving in vibrant settings as you reunite Doctor Acorn with his lost headlamp.
